label: D2 arrival at S1 after an unrewarded streak, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), and only when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward=0, reward input 0). 94% of mass is on steps where the reached state shown is S1. It is almost entirely confined to late episode trials: nothing before trial 40, rising sharply from trial 70, with a peak at trials 80-99. Rate goes up when the losses come in a streak: requiring the trial before that to also be unrewarded raises precision from 0.17 to 0.47 at the cost of recall. It fires with low model value (below about 7.1) and near-neutral policy logits. The strongest activations come at rare S1 arrivals (a2 to S1) after several unrewarded trials. It does not fire at D1 or GO, after a rewarded trial, or (much) at S2. All variables used are observed by D2; ep_trial is not an input, so the agent can only track it implicitly through its hidden state. The predicate is broad, with dev F1 around 0.43 and mass recall 0.88, so firing is clearly incomplete: many matching steps stay silent, which points to a dependence on the hidden-state level (a slow drift over the episode plus accumulated losses) rather than a crisp condition.
